title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story June #123 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics 0712-7774 Dave Sim 1989
descriptionText: This comic book is a single unit sale of Cerebus the Aardvark's Jaka’s Story, issue #123, published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in 1989. The comic book is boarded and features the artwork of Dave Sim. The story follows the character Cerebus, a superhero who is aardvark-shaped creature, in his adventures during the Copper Age of comics. The comic book is written in English and is part of the US Comics tradition.
